attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Nursing (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education within the 2 years before the application; at least 20 of the 30 hours specific to the specialty practice area
rules.alternatives: Current national certification must be documented (licensed after Sept 1984; lifetime certificants document continuing participation) and may be counted as 30 of the 60 total contact hours (RN + APRN). Completing a graduate nursing program within 2 years of the application replaces the 30 hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Graduate nursing program completed within 2 years of the application date meets the education requirement.
rules.audit_note: Pharmacology hours and national certification are uploaded into the online renewal application; every 100th renewal is selected for a CE audit.

topics.who: Pharmacology appropriate to the specialty practice area; part of the 30 APRN hours
3 of the 5 pharmacology hours: opioid prescribing, pain management or substance use disorder

rules.notes: APRN hours are in addition to the 30 contact hours for the RN license (60 total). Also needs 400 practice hours within 4 years (or recent graduate program) and a current NH or compact RN license. Renewal due by midnight on the birthday of the renewal year.
rules.legal_basis: N.H. Admin. Rules Nur 401.03 and Nur 403.01(d)
